name: Rico
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to flash, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This is essentially an arbitrary external call via the vulnerable flash function, letting the attacker directly invoke ERC20 transfer and transferFrom with almost no protocol-specific complexity. The exploit is straightforward, uses simple helper functions and routine swaps, and a competent auditor could reproduce it quickly once the missing validation/access control is noticed.
